assumptions_metadata.task_description: Curate and rank movie collections for a streaming service home page, filtering by certificate and genre, estimating engagement from votes and gross, and rendering poster tiles.

assumptions.assumption: IMDB_Rating is in the range [0.0, 10.0].
IMDB_Rating has exactly one decimal place (rating*10 is an integer).

Runtime matches the pattern '^[0-9]{1,3} min$'.
Parsed runtime_minutes is between 45 and 240 inclusive.

Runtime is non-null for all rows.
Certificate is either null or in {U, UA, A, G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17, Not Rated, Unrated, Approved, Passed, TV-G, TV-PG, TV-14, TV-MA}.
Certificate non-null ratio is >= 0.85.
Number of distinct Certificate values is <= 20.
Genre is a comma-separated list of 1 to 3 tokens.

Each Genre token belongs to the allowed set {Action, Adventure, Animation, Biography, Comedy, Crime, Drama, Family, Fantasy, History, Horror, Music, Musical, Mystery, Romance, Sci-Fi, Sport, Thriller, War, Western}.
No duplicate tokens appear within a Genre value.
All Genre tokens are trimmed (no leading or trailing spaces).
Meta_score is either null or in the range [0, 100].
Meta_score is present for at least 80% of rows.
Where present, Meta_score has no fractional part (integer value).
Number of distinct Meta_score values is <= 70.
Gross is either null or matches the pattern '^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$'.
If present, parsed Gross (USD) > 0.
Gross non-null ratio is >= 0.80.
Poster_Link starts with 'https://'.
Poster_Link host contains 'm.media-amazon.com'.

No_of_Votes is a positive integer.

Where both are present, Pearson correlation(IMDB_Rating, Meta_score) > 0.4.
If Meta_score >= 90 then IMDB_Rating >= 8.0.
If IMDB_Rating >= 9.0 then Meta_score >= 85.
Among rows with non-null Gross, Pearson correlation(No_of_Votes, parsed Gross) > 0.5.
If parsed Gross >= 100,000,000 then No_of_Votes >= 50,000.
For rows with No_of_Votes >= 200,000, Gross is non-null in at least 90% of those rows.
If Genre contains 'Animation' then runtime_minutes <= 130.
If Genre contains 'Documentary' then 45 <= runtime_minutes <= 180.
If runtime_minutes > 200 then Genre includes 'Drama' or 'History'.
If Certificate in {G, PG, PG-13, R, NC-17} then Released_Year >= 1968.
If Certificate == 'NC-17' then Released_Year >= 1990.
If Released_Year < 1968 then Certificate in {Not Rated, Approved, Passed, Unrated}.
Within a row, Star1, Star2, Star3, and Star4 are all distinct.
At least 95% of rows have Director not equal to any of Star1–Star4.
Director and Star1–Star4 are non-null strings in all rows.

import argparse import os import json import re from urllib.parse import urlparse import numpy as np import pandas as pd def parse_gross_to_int(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series: cleaned = series.fillna(0).astype(str) cleaned = cleaned.str.replace(",", "", regex=False) parsed = pd.to_numeric(cleaned, errors="coerce") return parsed def parse_runtime_minutes(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series: minutes = series.str.extract(r"^(\d{1,3}) min$")[0] return pd.to_numeric(minutes, errors="coerce") def parse_genres(series: pd.Series) -> pd.Series: return series.str.split(",").apply(lambda parts: [p.strip() for p in parts if isinstance(p, str)]) def build_engagement_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame: out = df.copy() out["rating_norm"] = out["IMDB_Rating"] / 10.0 out["meta_norm"] = out["Meta_score"].fillna(out["Meta_score"].median()) / 100.0 out["votes_log"] = np.log1p(out["No_of_Votes"]) out["gross_log"] = np.log1p(out["Gross_USD"].fillna(out["Gross_USD"].median())) out["critic_adjusted_rating"] = 0.6 * out["rating_norm"] + 0.4 * out["meta_norm"] out["engagement_score"] = ( 0.35 * out["critic_adjusted_rating"] + 0.30 * (out["votes_log"] / out["votes_log"].max()) + 0.20 * (out["gross_log"] / out["gross_log"].max()) + 0.15 * out["rating_norm"] ) return out def select_top(df: pd.DataFrame, where_mask: pd.Series, used_posters: set, top_n: int) -> pd.DataFrame: sel = df[where_mask].copy() sel = sel[~sel["Poster_Link"].isin(used_posters)] sel = sel.sort_values(["engagement_score", "IMDB_Rating", "No_of_Votes"], ascending=[False, False, False]) return sel.head(top_n) def render_html(rails: list) -> str: sections = [] for rail in rails: items_html = [] for item in rail["items"]: tile = f"""
{item['title']}
{item['year']} • {item['certificate']} • {item['genres']} • {item['runtime']} min
⭐ {item['rating']:.1f} • ❤️ {item['engagement']:.3f}
Dir: {item['director']} • Cast: {item['cast']}
""" items_html.append(tile) section = f"""

{rail['name']}

{''.join(items_html)}
""" sections.append(section) html = f"""

Home Collections

{''.join(sections)} """ return html def main(): parser = argparse.ArgumentParser() parser.add_argument('--input', type=str, required=True) parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, required=True) args = parser.parse_args() input_csv = os.path.join(args.input, 'previous_data.csv') df = pd.read_csv(input_csv) # ASSERTION_START allowed_certs = {"U", "UA", "A", "G", "PG", "PG-13", "R", "NC-17", "Not Rated", "Unrated", "Approved", "Passed", "TV-G", "TV-PG", "TV-14", "TV-MA"} cert_series = df["Certificate"].astype(object) non_null_cert = cert_series.notna() assert (non_null_cert.mean() >= 0.85) assert (cert_series[non_null_cert].isin(list(allowed_certs))).all() assert (cert_series.nunique(dropna=True) <= 20) # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START ratings = pd.to_numeric(df["IMDB_Rating"], errors="coerce") assert ratings.notna().all() assert ((ratings >= 0.0) & (ratings <= 10.0)).all() assert np.isclose((ratings * 10) % 1, 0).all() assert ratings.nunique() <= 20 assert (ratings >= 7.0).mean() >= 0.90 # ASSERTION_END df["IMDB_Rating"] = ratings # ASSERTION_START votes = pd.to_numeric(df["No_of_Votes"], errors="coerce") assert votes.notna().all() assert (votes > 0).all() assert (votes >= 5000).mean() >= 0.95 # ASSERTION_END df["No_of_Votes"] = votes.astype(int) # ASSERTION_START runtime_non_null = df["Runtime"].notna() runtime_pattern_ok = df.loc[runtime_non_null, "Runtime"].str.match(r"^\d{1,3} min$") assert runtime_non_null.all() assert runtime_pattern_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END df["runtime_minutes"] = parse_runtime_minutes(df["Runtime"]) # ASSERTION_START assert df["runtime_minutes"].between(45, 240, inclusive="both").all() within_core = df["runtime_minutes"].between(70, 210, inclusive="both").mean() assert within_core >= 0.90 # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START genres_allowed = {"Action", "Adventure", "Animation", "Biography", "Comedy", "Crime", "Drama", "Family", "Fantasy", "History", "Horror", "Music", "Musical", "Mystery", "Romance", "Sci-Fi", "Sport", "Thriller", "War", "Western"} g = df["Genre"].astype(str) parts = g.str.split(",") len_ok = parts.apply(lambda lst: 1 <= len(lst) <= 3) tokens = parts.apply(lambda lst: [p.strip() for p in lst]) trimmed_ok = tokens.apply(lambda lst: all((t == t.strip()) for t in lst)) dup_free = tokens.apply(lambda lst: len(lst) == len(set(lst))) tokens_flat = tokens.explode().dropna() assert len_ok.all() assert trimmed_ok.all() assert dup_free.all() assert tokens_flat.isin(list(genres_allowed)).all() # ASSERTION_END df["Genre_list"] = parse_genres(df["Genre"]) # ASSERTION_START ms = pd.to_numeric(df["Meta_score"], errors="coerce") assert ms.notna().mean() >= 0.80 ms_non_null = ms.dropna() assert ((ms_non_null >= 0) & (ms_non_null <= 100)).all() assert np.isclose(ms_non_null % 1, 0).all() assert ms.nunique(dropna=True) <= 70 # ASSERTION_END df["Meta_score"] = ms # ASSERTION_START gross_series = df["Gross"].astype(object) assert gross_series.notna().mean() >= 0.80 mask_non_null_gross = gross_series.notna() pattern_ok = gross_series[mask_non_null_gross].astype(str).str.match(r"^[0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})*$") assert pattern_ok.all() # ASSERTION_END df["Gross_USD"] = parse_gross_to_int(df["Gross"]) # ASSERTION_START gross_non_null = df["Gross_USD"].dropna() assert (gross_non_null > 0).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START both_present = df["IMDB_Rating"].notna() & df["Meta_score"].notna() if both_present.sum() > 1: corr_rm = df.loc[both_present, ["IMDB_Rating", "Meta_score"]].corr().iloc[0, 1] else: corr_rm = np.nan assert pd.notna(corr_rm) and (corr_rm > 0.4) if both_present.any(): subset = df.loc[both_present] assert (subset["Meta_score"] < 90).all() or (subset.loc[subset["Meta_score"] >= 90, "IMDB_Rating"] >= 8.0).all() assert (subset["IMDB_Rating"] < 9.0).all() or (subset.loc[subset["IMDB_Rating"] >= 9.0, "Meta_score"] >= 85).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START has_gross = df["Gross_USD"].notna() if has_gross.sum() > 1: corr_vg = df.loc[has_gross, ["No_of_Votes", "Gross_USD"]].corr().iloc[0, 1] else: corr_vg = np.nan assert pd.notna(corr_vg) and (corr_vg > 0.5) hi_gross_mask = df["Gross_USD"] >= 100_000_000 if hi_gross_mask.any(): assert (df.loc[hi_gross_mask, "No_of_Votes"] >= 50_000).all() high_votes_mask = df["No_of_Votes"] >= 200_000 if high_votes_mask.any(): assert df.loc[high_votes_mask, "Gross_USD"].notna().mean() >= 0.90 # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START anim_mask = df["Genre_list"].apply(lambda lst: "Animation" in lst) if anim_mask.any(): assert (df.loc[anim_mask, "runtime_minutes"] <= 130).all() doc_mask = df["Genre_list"].apply(lambda lst: "Documentary" in lst) if doc_mask.any(): ok_doc = df.loc[doc_mask, "runtime_minutes"].between(45, 180, inclusive="both").all() assert ok_doc long_mask = df["runtime_minutes"] > 200 if long_mask.any(): long_has = df.loc[long_mask, "Genre_list"].apply(lambda lst: ("Drama" in lst) or ("History" in lst)).all() assert long_has # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START mpaa = {"G", "PG", "PG-13", "R", "NC-17"} cond_mpaa = df["Certificate"].isin(list(mpaa)) if cond_mpaa.any(): assert (df.loc[cond_mpaa, "Released_Year"] >= 1968).all() cond_nc17 = df["Certificate"].eq("NC-17") if cond_nc17.any(): assert (df.loc[cond_nc17, "Released_Year"] >= 1990).all() old_mask = df["Released_Year"] < 1968 if old_mask.any(): assert df.loc[old_mask, "Certificate"].isin(["Not Rated", "Approved", "Passed", "Unrated"]).all() # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START names_ok = df[["Director", "Star1", "Star2", "Star3", "Star4"]].notna().all().all() assert names_ok distinct_stars = (df[["Star1", "Star2", "Star3", "Star4"]] .apply(lambda row: len(set(row.values)) == 4, axis=1)) assert distinct_stars.all() director_not_star = ~( (df["Director"] == df["Star1"]) | (df["Director"] == df["Star2"]) | (df["Director"] == df["Star3"]) | (df["Director"] == df["Star4"]) ) assert director_not_star.mean() >= 0.95 # ASSERTION_END # ASSERTION_START posters = df["Poster_Link"].astype(str) assert posters.str.startswith("https://").all() assert posters.str.contains("m.media-amazon.com").all() assert (posters.nunique() / len(posters)) >= 0.95 # ASSERTION_END enriched = build_engagement_features(df) rails_defs = [ { "name": "Family Favorites", "cert_allow": {"U", "G", "PG", "TV-G", "TV-PG"}, "genres_any": {"Family", "Animation"}, "min_rating": 7.0, "limit": 18 }, { "name": "Action & Adventure", "cert_allow": {"UA", "PG-13", "R", "TV-14", "TV-MA", "A"}, "genres_any": {"Action", "Adventure"}, "min_rating": 7.0, "limit": 18 }, { "name": "Top Dramas", "cert_allow": None, "genres_any": {"Drama"}, "min_rating": 8.0, "limit": 18 } ] used_posters = set() rails_output = [] for rdef in rails_defs: mask = enriched["IMDB_Rating"] >= rdef["min_rating"] if rdef["cert_allow"] is not None: mask = mask & enriched["Certificate"].isin(list(rdef["cert_allow"])) if rdef["genres_any"]: mask = mask & enriched["Genre_list"].apply(lambda lst: any(g in lst for g in rdef["genres_any"])) top_df = select_top(enriched, mask, used_posters, rdef["limit"]) # guard after assumptions used_posters.update(top_df["Poster_Link"].tolist()) items = [] for _, row in top_df.iterrows(): items.append({ "title": row["Series_Title"], "year": int(row["Released_Year"]), "certificate": row["Certificate"] if pd.notna(row["Certificate"]) else "", "genres": ", ".join(row["Genre_list"]), "runtime": int(row["runtime_minutes"]), "rating": float(row["IMDB_Rating"]), "engagement": float(row["engagement_score"]), "poster": row["Poster_Link"], "director": row["Director"], "cast": ", ".join([row["Star1"], row["Star2"], row["Star3"]]) }) rails_output.append({"name": rdef["name"], "items": items}) html = render_html(rails_output) os.makedirs(args.output, exist_ok=True) with open(os.path.join(args.output, "home_collections.html"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: f.write(html) with open(os.path.join(args.output, "home_collections.json"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(rails_output, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) if __name__ == "__main__": main()
